title: Verifying your student enrollment
summary: Explains how to verify active student enrollment per semester: submit one acceptable document (official enrollment letter, class schedule/registration summary, student portal screenshot, or tuition invoice/receipt) showing your name, institution, term, and enrollment status. Documents must be unredacted/not password-protected and uploaded via the secure account upload option; you’ll receive receipt confirmation or a prompt to resubmit with requested items.
faqs: How often do I need to verify my active student enrollment?
What documents are acceptable to prove my enrollment (letter, schedule, portal screenshot, or invoice)?
What details must be visible on my proof (name, institution, term, and enrollment status)?
How do I submit my verification documents through my account?
What file requirements apply (unredacted and not password-protected), and what formats are allowed?
What happens after I submit—do I get confirmation or requests for additional information?
